# aplyx — full site text

> aplyx is a local-first job-application agent. It searches job boards in one pass,
> deduplicates against your local history, checks each posting against your
> preferences with deterministic rule-based logic (not a model's guess), tailors a
> resume and cover letter grounded in your real resume, and applies through a
> browser or public APIs. Every application is reviewable before it goes out.

This file inlines the text of every page on https://aplyx.app/ so a crawler can
review the whole site in one request. Canonical HTML pages are linked per section.
Short index at https://aplyx.app/llms.txt. Last generated 2026-08-31.

Site map: `/` `/features.html` `/pricing.html` `/install.html` `/extension.html`
`/changelog.html` `/privacy.html`. Disallowed for crawlers: `/account.html`.

---

## Homepage — https://aplyx.app/

**Your job search, applied to.** aplyx searches job boards, tailors your resume,
and applies on your behalf. Every decision stays reviewable before it goes out.

By the numbers:

- 6+ boards searched in one pass, not one at a time.
- 0 times you copy-paste your resume into another form.
- 100% of applications stay reviewable before they're sent.
- 1 profile that tailors itself to every posting.

Core capabilities:

- **Multi-board search** — Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, Workday, and more, searched
  in one pass and deduplicated automatically.
- **Resume tailoring** — bullets and cover letters rewritten per job description,
  grounded in your actual resume.
- **Review before it goes out** — every application is reviewable; nothing goes
  out without a decision you control.
- **TUI + desktop** — a terminal app and a native desktop app, both driven by the
  same local-first core.

How it works — four steps, the same every time:

1. **Search** — every configured board is scanned in one pass, deduplicated
   automatically against what you've already seen.
2. **Fit-check** — each posting is checked against your role, level, and location
   preferences with plain deterministic logic, not a model's guess.
3. **Tailor** — bullets are rewritten and a cover letter drafted for that specific
   posting, grounded strictly in your real resume.
4. **Review & apply** — anything ready lands in your review queue; you decide
   before anything is submitted on your behalf.

After an application goes out, status keeps updating automatically from the first
response to the offer.

---

## Features — https://aplyx.app/features.html

One local-first pipeline, from finding postings to a reviewable, ready-to-send
application.

- **Multi-board search** — Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, Workday, SmartRecruiters, and
  more, searched in one pass and deduplicated automatically, so the same posting
  never shows up twice just because it's listed on two boards. Every result is
  fit-checked against your preferences in the same view.
- **A deterministic fit gate** — every posting is checked against your role, level,
  and location preferences with plain rule-based logic before anything reaches a
  resume-tailoring step. Not a model guessing whether a job is a fit.
- **Resume & cover letter tailoring** — keep one resume in aplyx (jobs, projects,
  skills, education, entered once). Bullets are rewritten and reordered per job
  description, and a short cover letter is drafted grounded strictly in your actual
  resume and the posting, never invented experience.
- **Review before it goes out** — anything uncertain lands in a review queue. Each
  entry shows its ATS score, the resume picked for it, and the fit-gate reasoning.
  Nothing is applied to on your behalf without a decision you control.
- **Status tracking, straight from your inbox** (work in progress) — once an
  application goes out, aplyx watches the inbox on your profile for what happens
  next (rejection, assessment, interview request, offer) and updates that job's
  status automatically. Read-only, opt-in, off by default. States: Applied, OA
  sent, Interview requested, Offer, Rejected.
- **TUI and desktop, same core** — a terminal app for a fast keyboard-first
  workflow, and a native desktop app for the same thing visually, both driven by
  the same local-first pipeline.
- **Discord updates, optional** — get pinged as applications go out, need review,
  or fail. Entirely opt-in and off by default.

## Pricing — https://aplyx.app/pricing.html

**Free forever, running locally.** Everything runs on your machine at no cost.
Hosted plans exist for when you'd rather not install anything, or run out of your
own coding agent's usage room.

### Free — $0

No account, no waitlist, no card. Just your own coding agent and your own machine.

- Every core feature: multi-board search, fit-gate, tailoring, and the review queue.
- Quick, guided setup.
- Preferred locations & companies.
- A real TUI for the terminal-first, and a polished desktop app as your search hub.
- Unlimited auto-applications, bounded only by your own coding agent's usage limits.
- Resume review, backed by a deterministic fit-gate score.
- Manual search across Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, Workday, SmartRecruiters, and more.
- Your personal information never leaves your machine.
- One resume profile. Discord updates optional.

### Planned hosted plans (previews — not live, pricing not final)

Hosted plans run your search and applications from aplyx's servers instead, so
there's no dependency on your agent's limits and no need to keep your own device
on and online for auto-apply.

- **Basic — $5/month** — full TUI & desktop app; guided setup with no local install
  or coding agent; up to 5 auto-applications/day; internship postings; hosted
  resume & cover-letter tailoring with review; one resume profile stored in a
  Supabase-backed database; community support.
- **Intern — $9/month** — as Basic, plus up to 10 auto-applications/day; email
  support; SMS & iMessage status tracking (planned); Discord communication
  (planned).
- **Pro — $13/month ("Most Valued")** — everything in Intern, plus internship &
  new-grad postings and a higher daily auto-application cap.

## Install — https://aplyx.app/install.html

One command. aplyx drives whichever coding agent you already have — full
capability with opencode or Claude Code.

The desktop app installs itself and walks you through setup (profile, resumes, the
rest). Command-line install:

- **macOS / Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keshm2/aplyx/main/src/scripts/install/install.sh | bash`
  — installs to `~/aplyx` (override with `APLYX_HOME`).
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keshm2/aplyx/main/src/scripts/install/install.ps1 | iex`
  — installs to `%USERPROFILE%\aplyx`.
- **npm:** `npm install -g @keshm/aplyx && aplyx` — same installer underneath.

**Coding agent (local use only):** running aplyx yourself needs a coding agent to
drive it. Full capability, browser-automated applies included, with opencode or
Claude Code. Codex CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI work on a smaller path: API-fed
boards only, with browser-only applications routed to your review queue. Planned
hosted plans skip this requirement entirely.

**What the installer installs:**

- The aplyx checkout, into `~/aplyx` (override with `APLYX_HOME`).
- The `aplyx` command, into `~/.local/bin` (override with `APLYX_BIN`).
- A `data/resumes/` folder for your base resumes.
- Your profile and job-target config, kept local-only and never uploaded.

**Env vars worth knowing:** `APLYX_HARNESS` forces a specific coding agent instead
of auto-detecting; `APLYX_SESSION_CAP` caps applications per run (1–25);
`APLYX_AUTO_UPDATE=0` turns off the update-on-launch check.

**Browser extension:** submitted to the Chrome Web Store. Until approved, load it
unpacked: clone the repo, `cd src/extension && npm install && npm run build`, open
`chrome://extensions`, enable Developer mode, Load unpacked, select
`src/extension/dist`. Then start the bridge:
`python3 src/scripts/runtime/extension_bridge.py`, and
`python3 src/scripts/runtime/extension_bridge.py --show-token` to get the token to
paste into the extension.

---

## Browser extension — https://aplyx.app/extension.html

**It notices the form before you do.** The extension watches for a real
application form on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or Workday (not every page you
visit) and asks before it does anything. Say yes, and it fills the form from your
profile. You still review every field and click submit yourself.

Four steps, every time:

1. **Detects** — watches for a real, fillable application form on a supported
   board; stays invisible everywhere else, including job listings and search pages.
2. **Asks** — a prompt drops down asking "Autofill this application with aplyx?", a
   real yes/no.
3. **Fills** — maps visible fields to your profile and fills only what it can
   answer honestly. Anything it can't is highlighted for you, never invented.
4. **You review & apply** — you check every field and click submit yourself. aplyx
   never clicks it for you, on any application, ever.

Supported boards: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday. Manifest V3.

## Privacy — https://aplyx.app/privacy.html

Plainly, not legally: what's collected, why, where it's stored, and what you can do
about it. Last updated August 26, 2026.

**Two ways to run aplyx:**

- **Local** (TUI or desktop app, no account) — your profile, resumes, and
  application history stay entirely on your machine, in files under your install
  directory. Nothing is uploaded by aplyx itself. Deleting the install directory
  is a complete deletion.
- **Hosted account** — stores your profile (name, contact info, setup fields) and
  resume file(s) in a cloud database so they're not stuck on one machine. ATS
  account credentials are stored separately in Supabase Vault, encrypted at rest
  and scoped to your account; ordinary queries return only masked details.

Other points:

- Gender, ethnicity, and date of birth are always optional (some employers ask on
  voluntary self-identification forms).
- Hosted data is scoped to your account by access rules — only requests
  authenticated as you can read or write it; no cross-account browsing.
- **Hosted does not yet run your job search, tailoring, or application steps** —
  those still happen on your own machine via your own coding agent, exactly like
  local mode. A fully server-run version is planned and would get its own explicit
  consent step first.
- **Model provider** — resume tailoring and cover-letter drafting send the
  relevant job description and your resume content to your coding agent's model
  provider API, the same as using that agent directly.
- A separate non-personal cache of public job postings speeds up search for all
  users, refreshes on the order of hours, and is never linked to your identity.
- Data in transit is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS). Hosted data at rest has per-account
  access controls plus disk-level encryption.
- Retention: hosted profile and application-history records are removed when you
  delete your account; uploaded resume files currently need a manual step by
  request until self-serve deletion is built.
- Not directed to children under 16.
- Contact / data requests: open an issue or discussion on
  https://github.com/keshm2/aplyx.
